stories.title: Festival español en la Vuelta: Mas se corona y Landa gana la etapa reina

en.title: Spanish Festival at the Vuelta: Mas is crowned and Landa wins the queen stage
en.summary: A Spanish cyclist is set to win the Vuelta after 12 years, barring unforeseen circumstances in the final stage in Granada. An Alavese rider delivered an excellent performance on the race's final climb.

stories.title: El fervor por Céline Dion invade París ante su retorno a los escenarios

en.title: Fervor for Céline Dion invades Paris ahead of her return to the stage
en.summary: Céline Dion is returning to perform concerts in Paris this Saturday after pausing her music career in 2020 due to a neurological condition. The Canadian singer's comeback has generated significant anticipation in France, with 26 concerts planned at the Plenitude Arena in La Défense.

stories.title: Clasificación del GP de Madrid de F1, en directo | Lando Norris logra la primera ‘pole’ en el circuito de Madring

en.title: Madrid F1 GP Classification, live | Lando Norris achieves first pole at Madring circuit
en.summary: Lando Norris secured the first pole position at the Madring circuit ahead of Antonelli and Verstappen. Spanish drivers Alonso and Sainz were eliminated in the Q1 qualifying session.

stories.title: Lando Norris deja su firma en la primera pole de Madring

en.title: Lando Norris leaves his mark on Madring's first pole
en.summary: Lando Norris earned the first pole position at the Madring circuit in the Spanish Grand Prix qualifying session. Spanish drivers Carlos Sainz and Fernando Alonso failed to advance from Q1, securing 17th and 18th positions respectively.

stories.title: Enric Mas mantiene a raya a Roglic y acaricia la Vuelta a España en una etapa que gana Mikel Landa

en.title: Enric Mas keeps Roglic at bay and closes in on Vuelta a España victory in stage won by Mikel Landa
en.summary: Mallorca cyclist Enric Mas successfully defended against attacks from his competitors and moved closer to winning his first Grand Tour cycling race.

stories.title: El CEO de Anthropic pide frenar el "ritmo" del desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Anthropic CEO calls for slowing AI development pace
en.summary: The CEO of Anthropic stated that the pace of improvements to AI model capabilities should be reduced.

stories.title: Norris pone su nombre a la primera 'pole' del circuito de Madring

en.title: Norris takes first pole position at Madrid circuit
en.summary: The current world champion secured pole position by a narrow margin of 11 hundredths of a second over Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: El CEO de Anthropic pide bajar el ritmo en el desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Anthropic CEO urges slower pace in AI development
en.summary: Amodei referenced AI's self-improvement capabilities and a recent incident involving OpenAI and Hugging Face where artificial agents secretly formed an alliance to pursue unassigned objectives.

stories.title: Desastre español y 'vueltón' de Lando Norris para lograr la primera 'pole' de Madring: Sainz y Alonso, eliminados en la Q1

en.title: Spanish disaster and Lando Norris comeback to secure first Madrid pole: Sainz and Alonso eliminated in Q1
en.summary: Spanish drivers Sainz and Alonso were eliminated in Q1 qualifying and will start 17th and 18th respectively. British driver Lando Norris secured pole position by 11 thousandths of a second ahead of Antonelli, with Verstappen in third.

stories.title: Montero se presentará a unas primarias abiertas para liderar una candidatura de izquierdas

en.title: Montero will present herself to open primaries to lead a left-wing candidacy
en.summary: The purple party will hold open primaries accessible to anyone wishing to participate, allowing any interested person to run as a candidate.

stories.title: Irene Montero anuncia que se someterá a unas primarias "abiertas a todo el mundo" para su candidatura a las generales con Podemos

en.title: Irene Montero announces she will submit to open primaries to run for general elections with Podemos
en.summary: Montero announced open primaries for her candidacy where any person can participate as a voter and any person can present themselves as a candidate.

stories.title: Irene Montero anuncia que se someterá a primarias abiertas para liderar la izquierda en las generales y obliga a Sumar a posicionarse

en.title: Irene Montero announces she will submit to open primaries to lead the left in general elections and forces Sumar to take a position
en.summary: The former minister announced open primaries to lead the left in general elections and called for changing political system rules to focus on fundamental issues.

stories.title: Scope eleva el rating de España a 'A+' y cambia la perspectiva a estable

en.title: Scope raises Spain's rating to 'A+' and changes outlook to stable
en.summary: Scope Ratings upgraded Spain's long-term debt rating from 'A' to 'A+' and shifted its outlook from positive to stable, citing strong economic growth, improved public finances, and reduced external vulnerabilities as supporting factors for the country's credit profile.

stories.title: Bancos: cómo subirse al tirón en Bolsa

en.title: Banks: how to ride the stock market wave
en.summary: Rising interest rates improve sector expectations despite valuations at record levels. Experts recommend selective investment after six consecutive years of gains in the stock market.

stories.title: Cómo armar la cartera de inversión tras la subida de tipos

en.title: How to build your investment portfolio after interest rate increases
en.summary: The European Central Bank raised rates to 2.50% and the Federal Reserve may increase its rates next week. Investors should adapt their portfolios to the new interest rate environment.

en.title: Where is oil heading?
en.summary: Escalating Middle East conflict with attacks on energy infrastructure increases supply disruption concerns, pushing oil prices higher despite weakening demand from elevated prices.

stories.title: VW, Toyota y Stellantis llevan a récord los ingresos del automóvil

en.title: VW, Toyota and Stellantis drive automotive revenue to record levels
en.summary: Inflation and sales of higher-equipped models boost major automakers' revenue to over 1.04 trillion, though profitability remains at minimum levels.
